purpose: Named real-world radar platform cards with citation-anchored physics. Each card carries antenna gain, transmit chain, receiver chain, scan pattern, and declared detection envelope per target class — all derived from public vendor datasheets and OSINT (Janes, CSIS, Reuters, Bellingcat, RUSI). Strict-open posture: no measured-truth claim; vendor names allowed per the 20260518T160000Z naming-policy reversal.

license.notice: Pack content derived from public vendor datasheets and OSINT. No measured-truth or classified-tactics claim.

notes: Seven named radar platform cards currently in this pack: Saab Giraffe 1X (S-band 3D, US Army 2026 order); RTX KuRFS (Ku-band AESA 360°, LIDS); RTX AN/MPQ-64 Sentinel A4 (X-band 3D phased array, 75 km vs 0 dBsm fighter); SRC AN/TPQ-50 (L-band dual-mode counter-battery + air-surveillance); Lockheed Martin AN/TPQ-53 (S-band counter-battery + C-UAS via FAAD C2); HENSOLDT SPEXER 2000 3D MkIII (X-band AESA pulse-Doppler, 3-panel 360°); Blighter A800 Mk2 (Ku-band FMCW AESA, full 6-point RCS-vs-range datasheet anchor).
Remaining cards in the backlog (HENSOLDT TRML-4D, Echodyne EchoGuard/EchoShield, SRC Gryphon R1410, Robin Radar IRIS LRM, Leonardo DRS RADA nMHR, CETC YLC-48, Pantsir-S1) land in subsequent waves.

Each card's physical parameters are either declared by the vendor or derived from declared facts via radar physics (antenna gain via G = 4*pi*eta*A_phys/lambda^2; PRF from unambiguous range; dwell from scan rate × beamwidth; noise figure from band/year typical).
